tasks.title: Select, use and store hand tools
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the hand tools used, why they suit the task and how they are used/stored safely.

tasks.title: Maintain and sharpen hand tools
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show a maintenance/sharpening activity and explain how you know the tool is ready for use.

tasks.title: Select and safely use a power tool
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the tool, pre-use check, control measures and the work it is used for.

tasks.title: Store and check power tools after use
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show how the tool is checked, isolated and stored after use.

tasks.title: Identify timber type, properties and defects
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show real timber/materials and explain species/product type, characteristics and defects/decay risks.

tasks.title: Select mastics, fillers, preservatives or ironmongery
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the product/component and explain its purpose, suitability and any standard/manufacturer requirement.

tasks.title: Produce and use a jig
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the jig being made/used and explain how it improves repeatability or accuracy.

tasks.title: Check work against standards and specification
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the check, identify the requirement/tolerance and explain what you would correct if needed.

tasks.title: Explain today's work using construction terminology
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Explain the work to another person using the correct terms and show how your contribution supports the team goal.

tasks.title: Coordinate with the wider build or workshop team
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use a witness/reflection to show who you coordinated with, how individual needs were considered and the effect on the wider team.
